body.name: Measurable observation encoding \(\mathsf{Enc}_{p_n,L_n}\)
body.construction: For \(y=(\operatorname{vec}(X)^{\top},R,C^{\top})^{\top}\), let \(T_n^{\mathrm{enc}}=2^{L_n-p_n-\lceil\log_2(p_n+2)\rceil-4}\), \(\kappa_n=\mathbf 1\{\|y\|_\infty>T_n^{\mathrm{enc}}\}\), and \(\operatorname{rnd}_{p_n}(x)=2^{-p_n}\operatorname{nint}_{\mathrm{even}}(2^{p_n}x)\), where \(\operatorname{nint}_{\mathrm{even}}\) is nearest-integer rounding with ties to an even integer. Set \((\widetilde X,\widetilde R,\widetilde C)\) coordinatewise to \(\operatorname{rnd}_{p_n}(y)\) when \(\kappa_n=0\), and to zero when \(\kappa_n=1\). Thus \(\mathsf{Enc}_{p_n,L_n}(X,R,C)=(\widetilde X,\widetilde R,\widetilde C,\kappa_n)\); on \(\kappa_n=0\), every coordinate error is at most \(2^{-p_n-1}\), and every encoded numerator and exponent has total binary length at most \(L_n\).
